info.name: SavaPage Print
info.summary: Print Nextcloud files or folders directly on a SavaPage print server.
info.description:
## Print from Nextcloud to SavaPage
Send documents directly from Nextcloud to a [SavaPage](https://www.savapage.org) print server.
- Send a **single file** from the Files app context menu. - **Batch print** multiple files or whole folders; folders are expanded recursively on the server. - Allowed file types are enforced server-side, so only printable documents are sent. - Credentials are managed per user and can be synced automatically from SavaPage, or overridden by users when the administrator allows it. - Dedicated **SavaPage** sections in both Administration and Personal settings.
### Requirements
- Nextcloud 28 – 35 - PHP 8.3+ - A reachable SavaPage server
### Installation
Install SavaPage Print from the [Nextcloud App Store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/savapage), or download a release archive and enable it in your `apps` directory.
### How it works
When you choose *Print to SavaPage*, the app uploads the document to your SavaPage server (`{Server URI}/restful/v1/documents/print`) using your personal SavaPage ID and UUID. SavaPage then holds the document in its print queue for you to release at the printer.
[Read the full documentation](https://www.savapage.org) for administrator and user guides.
